content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I help my customers though building strong and lasting relationships with them. The best part of working for Nebula Trust is the opportunity to help my customers achieve their financial dreams.

A Little About Me

I joined Nebula Trust Bank in 1988 as a part-time teller in the Mystic Branch and worked my way to my current position as Customer Solutions Manager in the multiple citiesBranch.

I am a graduate of Ella T. Grasso Southeastern Regional Vocational Technical School and a 2018 Global School of Finance and Management graduate.

I am currently on the Board of Directors of the Covenant Shelter of multiple citiesand volunteer at various events throughout the year.
